import json
from pathlib import Path


_POLICY_PATH = Path(__file__).parent / "policy.json"


def load_policy() -> dict:
    with _POLICY_PATH.open("r", encoding="utf-8") as policy_file:
        return json.load(policy_file)


def can(user: dict, action: str, object: str, record: dict) -> bool:
    policy = load_policy()

    role = user.get("ROLE_ID", "")
    matching_grant = next(
        (
            grant
            for grant in policy.get("grants", [])
            if grant.get("role") == role
            and grant.get("object") == object
            and grant.get("action") == action
        ),
        None,
    )

    if matching_grant is None:
        return False

    if action == "DELETE" and record.get("DEL_FLG", "") not in ("", "N"):
        return False

    if role == policy.get("admin_role"):
        return True

    scope = matching_grant.get("scope")
    if scope == "ALL":
        return True
    if scope == "TEAM":
        return user.get("TEAM_CD", "") == record.get("TEAM_CD", "")
    if scope == "OWN":
        return record.get("OWNER_UID", "") == user.get("USR_ID", "")
    return False
